headline: Trump Invokes Defense Production Act for Oil Production and Refining
summary: Donald Trump invoked the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to boost domestic oil production and refining capabilities.
why: The Defense Production Act grants the U.S. president extensive authority to direct industrial production and secure critical national resources during emergencies.

impacts.name: Energy and Refining
impacts.why: Government intervention aims to accelerate domestic fossil fuel extraction and processing capacities.

why_moved: Emergency executive actions targeting domestic energy supply can alter short-term commodity pricing expectations and sector valuations.
